verdict.rationale: A security-key vendor could plausibly publish official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only end-user tools: an open-source CLI/GUI (fido2-manage, built on the third-party libfido2), companion apps, a PowerShell/Graph API bulk-enrollment script, and browser demos. None of these is a documented official SDK or client library to build against, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
